newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mostly firmer.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mostly firmer.

text.p: Feb 10 - Most IMM currency futures ended quiet trade firmer. Yen rose again late when a big fund bought. Other units stayed fairly subdued. Sterling built gains on sentiment UK economy is strongest in Europe, before Wed's quarterly BoE inflation report. March Can dollar hit 200-day moving average near $0.7396 after nearing intraday technical objective $0.7422. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
